title: check.py's lexical code scan misses a parenthesized docstring and one after a backslash-continued header
goal: code_comment_lines reads a docstring written as ("doc") or after a backslash line continuation in a def or class header as a docstring, as ast.get_docstring does

run: import sys,tempfile,os;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import check;p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'x.py');open(p,'w').write('def f():\n    (\x22doc\x22)\n');sys.exit(0 if [n for n,_ in check.code_comment_lines(p)]==[2] else 1)
